code: local RS=game:GetService("RunService") if _G.QACamConn then _G.QACamConn:Disconnect() end local off=Vector3.new(3.2,1.8,-7) _G.QACamConn=RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function() local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character local r=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not r then return end cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable local base=r.CFrame local pos=r.Position+base.RightVector*off.X+Vector3.new(0,off.Y,0)+base.LookVector*(-off.Z) cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(pos,r.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.2,0)) end) return "cam"

local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local c=p.Character local Cfg for _,m in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do if m:IsA("ModuleScript") and m.Name=="GameConfig" then local ok,r=pcall(require,m) if ok and r.MeadowEquipment then Cfg=r break end end end
local function give(id) for i,it in ipairs(Cfg.MeadowEquipment) do if it.Id==id then local f=i<=32 and "MeadowGearOwned" or "MeadowGearOwned2" local b=(i-1)%32 p:SetAttribute(f,bit32.bor(p:GetAttribute(f) or 0,bit32.lshift(1,b))) return i,it end end end
local ci=give("guardian_armor") p:SetAttribute("MeadowEquipChest",ci)
local wi,wit for i,it in ipairs(Cfg.MeadowEquipment) do if it.ModelKey and it.Slot=="Weapon" and not it.Bow and Cfg.GearWeaponClass[it.Id]=="Sword" then wi,wit=give(it.Id) break end end
if wi then p:SetAttribute("MeadowEquipWeapon",wi) end
local si,sit for i,it in ipairs(Cfg.MeadowEquipment) do if it.Slot=="Shield" then si,sit=give(it.Id) break end end
if si then p:SetAttribute("MeadowEquipShield",si) end
return "chest="..tostring(ci).." weapon="..tostring(wit and wit.Id).." shield="..tostring(sit and sit.Id)
for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then g.Enabled=false end end return "ui off"

local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local c=p.Character local o={} for _,ch in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do if ch.Name:find("Meadow") then table.insert(o,ch.Name.." "..ch.ClassName) end end return table.concat(o,",")
